authorization: etymologise remaining Indo-Aryan surveys. do not rebuild. work autonomously and do what you can, you have 8 hours, i will review once your time is done.

proposals.evidence: Turner gives Punjabi sāī̃, Hindi sā̃ī and Maithili saĩẽ husband under svāmin, via Middle Indo-Aryan sāmi/sāhi. These nasalized survey sãi/sāhi forms fit that documented husband term; final -ek is retained as ordinary survey-context morphology. Less diagnostic sāhek and learned-looking swāmi forms are excluded.
